# CT TAVI work-up (non-valvular findings): Dr Fiona Marchetti (fictional)

Consultant cardiothoracic radiologist at a fictional regional NHS structural heart centre. She reports only the non-valvular part of the TAVI CT and points to a separate structural heart report for valve planning.
Her voice is terse and label-led: "Organ: fragment. Fragment." Access is a labelled measurement block (Right/Left: CIA, EIA, CFA in mm). She uses "unremarkable" and writes out "minimal luminal diameter" in full.
The conclusion is numbered and closes with a fixed defer-to-structural-report paragraph. When access is narrow, an alternative-access sentence goes in just before that paragraph.
Incidental nodule wording follows BTS. Nodules of 5 mm or more get a fitness-conditional surveillance sentence. Smaller ones are called sub-threshold.
